reply.summary: Soont is a gem-powered adventuress who joins a gang of crooks for money, grumbles about their manners, and quits whenever pay is in doubt. Soont ferries teammates through the air on shimmering violet light and turns on a leader when a better offer arrives.

feats.scene: Soont hurls a violet blast that levels a chemical plant gatehouse.
Soont shrugs off a hangar door slamming into her shoulder.
Soont carries three passengers across a bay in a single glittering streak.

reply.summary: Eonne is a violet-eyed villain who wields a beam of gem-bright power and soars above the skyline of a seaside city. Eonne works for a cabal of costumed schemers and takes part in a final raid on a rival team.

feats.scene: Eonne sweeps a beam across a rooftop and melts a row of antennas.
Eonne lands hard on a parking deck and walks off the crater.

reply.summary: Tiuamam is a shrewd airplane company director in a mirrored world who sells warplanes and weapons to whichever buyer pays the most. Tiuamam never fights and wins through contracts, bribery and cold logic.

feats.scene: Tiuamam signs a delivery order that sends a convoy of fighters overseas.
Tiuamam stays seated through a boardroom shoving match.

reply.summary: Llrne is an early-century suffragist with a green ring and a power battery who fights for the vote with glowing constructs. Llrne creates shields, fires bolts and flies over crowds that scoff at her cause.

feats.scene: Llrne forms a glowing hammer and flattens a steam wagon.
Llrne's field holds as a collapsing cornice rains bricks around her.
Llrne dashes over rooftops faster than a telegraph clerk can type.

reply.summary: Toceo is the head of an aircraft firm who is chosen by a love-fuelled ring and carried to a distant violet homeworld. Toceo gives the ring back, then takes it up again after a duel that proves care outlasts anger.

feats.scene: Toceo fires a violet beam that shatters a fleet of hovering drones.
Toceo stays in the air as a rival's crimson blast scorches her cloak.
Toceo shoots between canyon walls on a ribbon of rose light.

reply.summary: Ntotereon is a kindhearted aircraft executive who keeps an eye on a worried test pilot and reassures him in private moments. Ntotereon is caught in a distant invasion and is lost with her whole coastal city.

feats.scene: Ntotereon slaps a stuck hangar latch until it pops.
Ntotereon holds on to a rail as a runway tremor knocks over crates.

reply.summary: Carse is a black-haired ring-bearer in a cartoon world who draws glowing shapes out of thin air and fires bolts at her foes. Carse carries a power battery and flies skilfully, thanks to a pilot's training.

feats.scene: Carse conjures a pink wrecking ball and drops it on a rooftop sniper nest.
Carse bounces back from a ricocheting blast and keeps pace.
Carse spirals over a skyline in a bright loop.

reply.summary: Teernest is a plastic-brick heroine who teaches the power of affection to a scowling rival, with a ring that builds shields, blasts and shortcut jumps. Teernest is a photographer and trained pilot with only basic hand-to-hand skill.

feats.scene: Teernest builds a glowing launcher and pops a robot gang into scattered bricks.
Teernest lets a tumbling pillar bounce off her bubble.

reply.summary: Torniarni is a secretive woman of an alternate gaslit age who hides behind a gem-bright persona. Torniarni stays out of most conflicts and keeps her real motives to herself.

feats.scene: Torniarni sends a violet flare through a locked stairwell door.
Torniarni steps away from a collapsing balcony with her cape smoking.

reply.summary: Torsir is a red-haired farm-town mother who loses her husband on the very day their newborn comes home. Torsir and her mate are taken by metal hunters and die under cruel tests, leaving the baby orphaned.

feats.scene: Torsir shields the infant with her arms and shoves a kidnapper off the car step.
Torsir endures hours of restraint without giving way.

reply.summary: Vaanutal is a divorced legal secretary at a busy law firm who keeps files in order and answers phones with calm. Vaanutal knows the practice better than most partners.

feats.scene: Vaanutal slams a heavy filing drawer shut on a thief's fingers.
Vaanutal shrugs off a day of crowded commutes and angry callers.

reply.summary: Ninianium is a typist promoted to personal assistant for a wealthy playboy who is blackmailed through her child. Ninianium quietly copies documents for a kidnapper and tries hard not to be seen.

feats.scene: Ninianium swings a heavy typewriter lid at a lurking guard.
Ninianium stays on her feet after being shoved against a desk.

reply.summary: Leori is a former patrol officer who drifted into an extremist cell, switched sides, and was taken to an island of warrior women. Leori now commands them under a new name and gains a long life while she stays there.

feats.scene: Leori vaults a counter and disarms a gunman with one wrist twist.
Leori takes a spear haft across the ribs and keeps drilling recruits.

reply.summary: Rnuvaos is a blond crimefighter of an earlier generation whose voice can shatter glass and break a villain's nerve. Rnuvaos hides an infant from danger, retires, and is later hunted by an old enemy's heir.

feats.scene: Rnuvaos unleashes a cry that blows out every window of a warehouse.
Rnuvaos rolls through a shattered skylight and rises ready to fight.

reply.summary: Cetelces is a college student and devoted goddaughter of a revered teacher, kidnapped and tortured by a spy who wants family secrets. Cetelces is rescued once, captured again, and becomes bait for a duel she cannot stop.

feats.scene: Cetelces kicks free of a chair and cracks it against a captor's shin.
Cetelces withstands hours of questioning without a word.

reply.summary: Nenvalsas is a mountain-raised monk-trained fighter who prefers to calm a brawl with words and a slap than a killing blow. Nenvalsas, once a nomad child, escapes her family's murderers and fights evil beside two friends until an old rival ends her.

feats.scene: Nenvalsas drives a palm into a gang leader and sends him through a market stall.
Nenvalsas gets up from a staircase fall and bows to her student.

reply.summary: Iurimil is a blue-skinned hired fighter with white eyes and red hair, who runs very fast and bounces off walls without injury. Iurimil also flings himself skyward from rooftops and can glide long distances, and he scrambles the powers of a light-bending foe.

feats.scene: Iurimil ricochets off a pillar and flattens a squad of ambushers.
Iurimil bounces off a concrete wall at full speed and lands lightly.
Iurimil blurs through a shopping hall in a zigzag streak.

reply.summary: Vatan is a red-haired former special agent who lost her memory and mind after a lab procedure, and who now kills in the name of devotion. Vatan fires arrows with deadly accuracy and leaves bodies as love gifts for a masked archer.

feats.scene: Vatan fires a heavy arrow through a car door and pins the driver's sleeve.
Vatan keeps shooting with a cracked rib after a rooftop fall.

reply.summary: Varnu is a sidekick in a bright cartoon world, trained in martial arts, who once held two powerful rings after a cosmic reset. Varnu serves a bat-themed guardian and a celebrated league, and later loses the rings with the world's rebirth.

feats.scene: Varnu spin-kicks a lantern-lit golem and cracks its stone chest.
Varnu lands from a high ledge and rolls to her feet.

reply.summary: Sauresco is a gifted battlefield surgeon of an island of warrior women, famous for a sharp tongue and a poor bedside manner. Sauresco heals a troubled young girl and falls while treating wounded fighters on the front line.

feats.scene: Sauresco drives a spear shaft into an attacking machine's joint and halts it.
Sauresco stays at a patient's side as a blast tosses tents around her.

reply.summary: Ralle is a dying evidence-handler who grabs a magic wand that grafts itself onto his arm, stabilising his illness and giving him power over matter. Ralle takes a mall hostage, bitter at being overlooked, and clashes with heroes who tower over everyone.

feats.scene: Ralle transmutes a food court into lead and shatters a wall of the mall.
Ralle stands in the middle of a crashing atrium and shrugs off debris.

reply.summary: Rintiva is a winged crimefighter with a heavy mace and a flight harness who is also a reborn ancient prince. Rintiva is stronger and tougher than any human, heals fast, ages slowly, and sees farther than a hawk in a video-game city.

feats.scene: Rintiva swings the mace and caves in an armoured truck.
Rintiva crashes through a billboard and gets up unmarked.
Rintiva dives from a tower and levels out above the street.

reply.summary: Riiar is a museum curator and digger of tombs whose soul keeps returning in new bodies since an ancient prince touched alien metal. Riiar has worn many names across centuries, flies on metal wings and has a messy, tangled life story.

feats.scene: Riiar brings a mace down on a stone pillar and splits it.
Riiar takes a collapsing temple roof on his back and rises.
Riiar swoops above the dunes in a long glide.

reply.summary: Ntili is an archaeologist in a feathered flight rig who defends a mountain refuge for a corrupt president. Ntili fights hard with a metal mace but is overwhelmed by the dark knight he is sent to stop.

feats.scene: Ntili swings the mace and caves in a bunker door.
Ntili crashes through a gantry and still staggers up.
Ntili banks around a rock tower before the guards track him.

reply.summary: Numtiantu is a white-haired scientist who fakes his death and hides for years, then is found by a time-bending thug. Numtiantu's time machine tempts abusers of history until a younger self from fifteen years earlier steps in with lethal force.

feats.scene: Numtiantu overloads a machine core and blows out a lab wall.
Numtiantu withstands rough handling by hired captors.

reply.summary: Amsarni is a schoolmate turned clown-gang boss who builds a fiefdom in a ruined city after a machine overlord wrecks the world. Amsarni fools followers with a fake idol, hides a ruthless streak and is struck down by the lackey he betrayed.

feats.scene: Amsarni triggers a rigged bomb and collapses a bridge arch.
Amsarni slides along the pavement after a tumble and keeps grinning.

reply.summary: Raulorva is a black-haired firebug who runs a profitable burning-for-hire racket with a sibling. Raulorva takes his own life after an accidental death on a job, and the sibling vanishes into a faked end.

feats.scene: Raulorva torches a warehouse and the blaze consumes the whole block's roof.
Raulorva steps out of a smoky stairwell with singed sleeves.

reply.summary: Telellu is a huntress of an island of warrior women, trained in archery, riding and blade work, with a tracker's patience. Telellu is tougher and faster than mortals and patrols the forest edge for prey and intruders.

feats.scene: Telellu looses an arrow that pins a boar to an oak at long range.
Telellu keeps tracking after a rockslide grazes her shoulder.
Telellu sprints through undergrowth faster than the stag she hunts.

reply.summary: Satum is a cheerful red-haired heroine from a storybook galaxy who steps into the real world and tries to fit in. Satum navigates starships, wields electric power, and fights with trained martial skills alongside a band of oddball allies.

feats.scene: Satum arcs lightning from her palms and fuses the lock of a vault.
Satum hits the deck of a spinning ship and bounces up laughing.

reply.summary: Rallluora is a generous, quirky ex-paramedic who was dreamed into being by a living street and now drives a team's home through time and space. Rallluora began as a storybook gadget heroine and now steers a strange vehicle with vast reach.

feats.scene: Rallluora punches the accelerator and the whole vehicle tears through a barrier of time.
Rallluora grips the wheel as the cabin shakes and loses nothing but a hat.

reply.summary: Auter is a bitter, cynical double conjured by a living street to fit a scheming villain's needs, with the drive to help him travel through time. Auter leads a shadowy organisation against the street and its allies and falls when the original shows up.

feats.scene: Auter slams a lever and a rift tears a wall off a house.
Auter stumbles from a collapsing hall unhurt.

reply.summary: Tisloseo is a green-eyed lab technician at a corporation who studies the wreckage of a machine intelligence. Tisloseo's body is seized by escaped liquid, and she only mutters in an alien tongue before dying in care.

feats.scene: Tisloseo pushes a steel cart across a lab and crushes a monitor.
Tisloseo stays upright as hazardous fluid pours across her sleeves.

reply.summary: Rinonus is a steam-train driver who hauls mail and freight across the continent in a streamlined engine, and now and then fights bandits atop moving cars. Rinonus once outfought five train robbers on a speeding roof and is always on schedule.

feats.scene: Rinonus slams the throttle and drives the locomotive through a barricade of ties.
Rinonus clings to a hot boiler rail as the train sways around a curve.
Rinonus pushes the engine along a straight stretch at full steam.

reply.summary: Aranuiu is a nightclub-owning racketeer who deals arms under a flashy name while intelligence officers close in. Aranuiu tries to poison a visiting officer's date, and the plan backfires when the wrong guest drinks the cup.

feats.scene: Aranuiu pulls a lever and drops a stage trapdoor under an intruder.
Aranuiu absorbs a punch from a bouncer and stays standing.

reply.summary: Naniu is a fitness trainer cast out by her village after posing as a boy to become a holy ascetic. Naniu teaches a young pupil to endure agony by sleeping on nails, and later weathers a group attack without showing any pain.

feats.scene: Naniu snaps a staff across her knee and strikes the attacker's wrist.
Naniu absorbs a flurry of blows from several men and stays calm.

reply.summary: Autorte is a grey-eyed spy in a kingdom of knights who works in dungeons below a rival warrior realm. Autorte slips past guards, frees a captive prince, and begs him to end the war among the three realms.

feats.scene: Autorte lifts a key ring and unlocks a cell without a sound.
Autorte falls from a dungeon ledge and lands soundlessly.

reply.summary: Amrni is a blond newswoman who is charmed by a fake hero and spreads his stories to the public. Amrni is later changed into a clawed, feral thing by his sorcery and perishes beside her master.

feats.scene: Amrni claws through a car door and tosses it across a street.
Amrni shrugs off a heavy crate falling on her shoulder.

reply.summary: Terivi is a pint-sized masked vigilante in a cartoonish city who wields a sword and a belt full of gadgets. Terivi joins two friends to chop through giant weeds when a plant-loving villain smothers the streets.

feats.scene: Terivi swings the blade through a thick vine and cuts a lamppost in half.
Terivi tumbles from a rooftop and bounces into a roll.

reply.summary: Neslarn is a silent child raised by an assassin to become the perfect killer, who learns to read bodies instead of words. Neslarn leaves that life behind, swears never to kill again, and becomes a nightly guardian in a dark city.

feats.scene: Neslarn lands a roundhouse that knocks a thug through a plank door.
Neslarn keeps fighting after a fall through a glass roof.
Neslarn sprints along a roofline to catch a thief.

reply.summary: Raileri is a daughter of killers who reads rivals' muscles and moves to predict their next strike and answers questions with her fists. Raileri was once a covert operative and now guards a hill neighbourhood, under many nicknames.

feats.scene: Raileri slips a punch and drives an elbow into a gunman's rifle, snapping it.
Raileri takes a full tackle from a heavy and does not give ground.

reply.summary: Naunumco is a black-haired crimefighter in a bright animated city, a member of a caped family who fights at night. Naunumco appears briefly and leaves little detail beyond a quick sense of humour and good aim.

feats.scene: Naunumco throws a gadget that wraps a robber's legs.
Naunumco lands from a window ledge in a neat crouch.

reply.summary: Amnti is a possible-future vigilante who once rose from the grave after a timeline shift and joined an army of grown heroes. Amnti is skilled with blades and throwing weapons, and dies in a duel on a lonely quest for answers.

feats.scene: Amnti flicks a throwing blade through a steel fence post.
Amnti climbs out of a shallow grave and brushes off the dirt.

reply.summary: Ereria is a green-eyed cat burglar who grew up in the same orphanage as a famous thief and copies her career. Ereria builds a similar costume and kit, picks fights with her rival, and ends up handed to the police.

feats.scene: Ereria lashes a whip around a jewel case and snaps it loose.
Ereria drops from a skylight and tumbles upright.

reply.summary: Rnralu is an elderly blind woman in a retirement home who can see a person's future when she touches them. Rnralu warns a young visitor of a death close to him, then dies from the shock of a darker man's vision.

feats.scene: Rnralu squeezes a visitor's hand and a vision floods the room.
Rnralu sits calmly through a long afternoon of unwanted visits.

reply.summary: Llutel is a blond protester in a wartime alternate world who calls for help against unjust detention and later carries a fallen heroine's shield. Llutel and a friend wear silver gear conjured by a shape-shifter and march together as one team.

feats.scene: Llutel throws the shield and knocks a guard's rifle from his hands.
Llutel blocks a charging soldier with the shield and holds the line.

reply.summary: Lanluci is a young demigod who borrows magic gauntlets and winged sandals before she learns who her father is. Lanluci wields a lasso of lightning, hits as hard as a storm, and keeps a photo of an old flame close at hand.

feats.scene: Lanluci whips the lightning lasso and drops a tower of rubble.
Lanluci stands up from the rubble of a flattened gatehouse.
Lanluci streaks along a harbour in the winged sandals.

reply.summary: Reosaor is the angry, blond, globe-trotting child of an archaeologist and a demigod, and granddaughter of a thunder king. Reosaor tears into trouble to work out her fury, leaping between teams of young heroes.

feats.scene: Reosaor punches a stone colossus and cracks it from head to foot.
Reosaor takes a falling bridge span on her back and rises.
Reosaor charges across a plaza faster than a sports car.

reply.summary: Amosiva is a hulking street tough in a gang of fast-driving hoodlums who relies on raw strength. Amosiva has little backstory, but crumples parked cars and shoves rivals through shop windows.

feats.scene: Amosiva flips a parked car onto its roof with one heave.
Amosiva walks off a swing from a steel pipe with a grunt.

reply.summary: Isartau is a blond sprinter from a cold country, one of a trio engineered to match a famous runner, who joins a courier firm in a new land. Isartau delivers parcels at astonishing speed, gives charity time on weekends, and falls while climbing a wall.

feats.scene: Isartau sprints through a door and splinters it with a shoulder.
Isartau skids across a loading dock and bounces up.
Isartau races up a tower wall on a delivery run.

reply.summary: Riasotiu is a black-haired masked burglar who prowls rooftops like a feline and sets traps for a beetle-themed hero. Riasotiu appears only briefly, but leaves behind torn rooftops and claw marks.

feats.scene: Riasotiu springs from a gutter and slashes a security cable.
Riasotiu lands on a fire escape with a soft thud.
